name: HellFireSMP PE
description:
Do you want to re-experience nostalgic Minecraft just like it was back in 2013?

Look no further — we’ve got you covered!

HellFireSMP PE aims to recreate the classic vanilla Minecraft experience from 2013, enhanced with a selection of carefully chosen plugins.

Mine, build, and survive. Sell resources to others or buy what you need from fellow players. You can even start your own guild and team up with your friends.

Plugins we currently use:

- Authentication system

- Infinite worlds

- Extensive economy system

- ChestShops

- TreeChopper

- Advancements

- AI-controlled mobs

- Anti-spam chat filter

- Online counter

- Guilds

- Homes

- And many more...

In the "🔥┃information" channel under the "📌┃HELLFIRE PE (0.8.1 ALPHA)" category, you can find useful guides for the plugins we use.

These guides explain how each plugin works and list the available commands.

Installation guides for Minecraft 0.8.1 ALPHA on iOS, Android, Windows, and Linux can be found in our Discord server in the "🔥┃installation-guides" channel under the "📌┃HELLFIRE PE (0.8.1 ALPHA)" category.

Also check out our main project: HellFireSMP & Helkour.

Join our Discord server!
